generate_task_list_markdown: run the script to generate a categorized markdown task list from the ParlAI task_list into task_list.inc
extract_task_categories: run the script to extract and sort all unique task tags from the ParlAI task_list
categorize_tasks_by_tags: run the script to group ParlAI tasks into categories based on their tags with uncategorized fallback
build_task_code_urls: run the script to generate GitHub code URLs for each ParlAI task entry
format_task_links: run the script to format task links and descriptions into markdown with admonition notes
